# Test files allowed to fail without blocking CI or the automated release
# (sync-and-release.yml). Every entry here must be a bug confirmed on a
# CLEAN upstream checkout (not just this fork) -- verify with:
#   git worktree add /tmp/check <upstream-tag>
#   lua5.4 /tmp/check/tests/_test_foo.lua
# before adding a line, and remove the line the moment upstream ships a fix
# (the runner still executes these tests every run, so a fixed one starts
# reporting PASS again -- that's your cue to delete it here).
#
# Without this, any test upstream ships broken (on their own checkout, not
# from anything this fork did) would block every future sync forever, since
# the gate can't otherwise tell "pre-existing upstream bug" from "our merge
# broke something". See RELEASE.md for the manual-release fallback and how
# a failure gets triaged before landing here.
#
# format: one tests/_test_*.lua basename per line, '#' comments allowed.
#
# (empty right now -- the v5.1.0 _test_list_row_budget.lua entry was removed
# in v5.1.1, once upstream's own fix landed and it started reporting PASS.)
